greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo nenceba kaThixo uTata wethu kunye neNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kubani na nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele inceba. Kristu, usivele inceba. Nkosi, usivele inceba.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona umntu ehleli ecaleni kwendlela, emnyama yonke into kuye. Akaboni nqwelo-moya ibhabha phezulu, akaboni mibala yezityalo, akaboni nkqu nobuso babantu abahamba ngakuwo. KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu usondela eJeriko, kwaye kukho indoda eyimfama ehlala apho, ilinde, icela uncedo. Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Le mfama ayiboni ngenxa yokuba amehlo ayo avalekile, kodwa intliziyo yayo ivulekile. Xa isiva ukuba uYesu uyadlula, ayithuli. Ikhwaza kakhulu, 'Yesu, Nyana kaDavide, ndivele inceba!' Abantu bayayikhalimela, bayixelela ukuba ithule, kodwa yona ikhwaza nangakumbi. Le yindlela yomthandazo onyanisekileyo—ukukhwaza uThixo naxa umhlaba ufuna ukuba uthule.

UBenjamin Vo wayeyiqonda le nyaniso ngendlela yakhe. Khumbula indlela awayethanda ngayo ukujonga iinqwelo-moya, ngakumbi i-Boeing 737. Wayehlala nobawo wakhe, bejonge phezulu, bebona indlela ezi nqwelo-moya zihamba ngayo, zisuka emhlabeni ziye kude. UBen wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo eyayikwazi ukubala imigama, ukuyila iinkqubo ze-AI, nokucinga ngale nkampani yakhe ye-'con chim airlines' eyayimenza agcigcise kwaye amomotheke ngalo lonke ixesha ethetha ngayo. UBen wayengafuni nje ukubona izinto ezibonakalayo; wayefuna ukubona ngaphaya, wayefuna ukubona indlela izinto ezisebenza ngayo, indlela i-cloud infrastructure enokudibanisa ngayo ihlabathi. Wayenokubona ubuhle obungabonwa ngabanye.

Kodwa masiyimele inyaniso namhlanje. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amaxesha apho ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Kukho ukudinwa okungafani nokudinwa komzimba; kukudinwa komphefumlo. Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo namhlanje, uYohane ubhala amazwi anzulu: 'Ndiwazi umsebenzi wakho, nokudinwa kwakho, nonyamezelo lwakho.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UThixo uyakubona ukudinwa kwakho. Uyabona xa uthwele umthwalo onzima, xa ubusuku bude kwaye ukukhanya kubonakala kude. UBen wayengumfana owayenonyamezelo. Khumbula indlela awayeyiqonda ngayo imidlalo, indlela awayezama ngayo kwibasketball, indlela awayengoyiki ngayo ukuzama into entsha, nokuba wayenokufunda kwiimpazamo zakhe. Wayengumfana owayehamba 'enyanisweni' njengoko uYohane esikhumbuza. Wayengumntwana owayephila kuthando, kwaye nangona engasekho emzimbeni, uthando lwakhe lusaqhubeka lukhanya.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Yesu wam, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kule Sakramente iNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela ngokwesakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngomoya wakho. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ulapha, kwaye ndizibophelela ngokupheleleyo kuwe. Ungaze undivumele ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Makube nani uxolo lukaThixo olugqithiseleyo ekuqondeni konke. Hamba ngoxolo.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela abo bonke abalilayo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: IsiFundiso sokuQala
readings.text: Isityhilelo sikaYesu Kristu, asinikwa nguThixo ukuba sibonise izicaka zakhe izinto ezimele ukwenzeka kungekudala. Wasazisa oko ngokuthumela ingelosi yakhe kwisicaka sakhe uYohane, ongqina ilizwi likaThixo nobungqina bukaYesu Kristu ngokuxela oko wakubonayo. Onoyolo lowo ufunda ngokuvakalayo, banoyolo nabo baphulaphula lo myalezo wesiprofeto, bagcine oko kubhaliweyo kuwo, kuba ixesha elimisiweyo likufuphi. UYohane, kwiibandla ezisixhenxe zaseAsiya: makube nenu ubabalo noxolo oluvela kulowo ukhoyo, nowayekhoyo, nozayo, nasemimoyeni esixhenxe ephambi kwetrone yakhe. Ndaziva iNkosi isithi kum: 'Kwingelosi yebandla laseEfese, bhala oku: Lowo ubambe iinkwenkwezi ezisixhenxe esandleni sakhe sokunene, ohamba phakathi kweziphatho zezibane zegolide ezisixhenxe, uthi: Ndiyayazi imisebenzi yakho, nokudinwa kwakho, nonyamezelo lwakho, nokuba awunakubanyamezela abangendawo; uvavanye abo bazibiza ngokuba ngabaPostile kodwa bengesibo, wafumanisa ukuba ngabakhohlisi. Ngaphezu koko, unonyamezelo, uva iintlungu ngenxa yegama lam, kwaye awudiniwe. Noko ke, ndinoku ngokuchasene nawe: ulahlekelwe luthando obunalo ekuqaleni. Qonda ukuba uwile kangakanani. Guquka, wenze imisebenzi obuyenza ekuqaleni. Kungenjalo, ndiya kuza kuwe, ndisuse isiphatho sesibane sakho endaweni yaso, ngaphandle kokuba uguquke.'

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Aboyisileyo ndiya kubondla emthini wobomi. Onoyolo umntu ongahambiyo ngokwecebo labangendawo, nangendlela yezoni, nangokuhlala phakathi kwabadelelayo. Kodwa udeliswa ngumthetho weNkosi, kwaye ucamngca ngomthetho wayo imini nobusuku. R. Aboyisileyo ndiya kubondla emthini wobomi. Unjengomthi otyalwe ecaleni kwamanzi abalekayo, ovelisa iziqhamo zawo ngexesha elifanelekileyo, namagqabi awo angaze abune. Konke akwenzayo kuyaphumelela. R. Aboyisileyo ndiya kubondla emthini wobomi. Akunjalo kwabangendawo, akunjalo; banjengomququ oqhutywa ngumoya. Kuba iNkosi iyayijonga indlela yamalungisa, kodwa indlela yabangendawo iyatshabalala. R. Aboyisileyo ndiya kubondla emthini wobomi.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Ekufikeni kukaYesu eJeriko, indoda eyimfama yayihleli ecaleni kwendlela icela uncedo, kwaye xa yeva isihlwele sidlula, yabuza ukuba kwenzeka ntoni. Bamxelela, 'UYesu waseNazarete uyadlula.' Yakhwaza, 'Yesu, Nyana kaDavide, ndivele inceba!' Abantu ababehamba phambili bayikhalimela, beyixelela ukuba ithule, kodwa yona yaqhubeka ikhwaza kakhulu, 'Nyana kaDavide, ndivele inceba!' UYesu wema, wayalela ukuba iziswe kuye; kwaye yakufika kufutshane, uYesu wayibuza, 'Ufuna ndikwenzele ntoni?' Yaphendula, 'Nkosi, ndicela ndibone.' UYesu wathi kuyo, 'Bona; ukukholwa kwakho kukusindisile.' Ngoko nangoko yabona, yaza yamlandela, izukisa uThixo. Xa abantu bakubonayo oko, bonke badumisa uThixo.

day: Monday of the Thirty-third Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
